UrlGuard now resolves the host and refuses loopback/private/link-local/reserved addresses, non-http\(s\) schemes and unusual ports, and redirects are not followed. Tested with the actual attack URLs.")

API rate limiting from Stage 4b \(throttle:api, 60/min per token or IP\). Tested.")
